entities.summary: Hensley Filemon Acasio Meulens, nicknamed "Bam Bam", is a Curaçaoan professional baseball coach and former player. He most recently was the hitting coach for the Colorado Rockies of Major League Baseball (MLB). Meulens was also the longtime manager of the Netherlands national baseball team, from 2013 to 2023.
